C-11.Name: Full editor context menu: native edit roles, undo/redo, share
C-11.Summary: User feedback after C-10: "теперь там в меню только 2 пункта… давай расширяй до уровня гигиены: вставить, отправить (поделиться) и так далее". Extend the native editor context menu to macOS-hygiene level: Undo, Redo, ---, Cut, Copy, Copy as HTML, Paste, ---, Select All, ---, Share. Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All become PredefinedMenuItem roles in the context-menu popup — identical behavior and OS-localized labels and auto-enablement to the Edit menu's native items, and real webview paste/copy fidelity (including rich clipboard data) with no clipboard permissions. Undo/Redo are custom items dispatched to muya.undo()/redo() because the app deliberately routes history through Muya (v2.1.3-beta remapped Cmd+Z away from the webview undo); a role would bypass Muya history. Share reuses mt_share_file (the title-bar share path) and appears only when the tab has a pathname.

Problem.Description: The C-10 menu (Copy / Copy as HTML / Select All) is too sparse for daily right-click hygiene.
Problem.RootCause: C-10 scoped to the reported gap only; paste/cut were believed impossible via the id-dispatched route.
Problem.Evidence: User session 2026-09-17; m009 build_native_menu already uses .cut()/.copy()/.paste() predefined items (Edit submenu) proving the role route; mt_window_popup_context_menu builds from ValidatedContextMenuItem::{Item,Separator} only.

Goals.R-1: Rust: ContextMenuItemSpec gains optional role ("cut" | "copy" | "paste" | "select_all"); validation whitelists roles, counts them as actionable, and ignores id/label for them; the popup builds PredefinedMenuItem variants (OS-localized labels, native enablement, responder-chain actions). Role clicks are not reported to JS (no pending id), dismissal semantics unchanged.
Goals.R-2: editor.vue menu: undo, redo (custom, muya.undo/redo), separator, cut, copy (roles), Copy as HTML (custom, C-3 path), paste (role), separator, Select All (CUSTOM — muya's context-aware selectAll: a table selects the table, a code block its content; the native role would always grab the whole document, diverging from Cmd+A), separator + Share (custom, shown only with a pathname; the native share sheet shows the file). The C-10 custom Copy item is replaced by the copy role; Select All stays custom (review pass 1).
Goals.R-3: Locales: contextMenu.editor gains undo/redo/share keys; the now unused copy key is removed (its role label comes OS-localized) while selectAll stays for the custom context-aware item. All ten locale PAIRS (json + min.json).
Goals.R-4: Tests: Rust validation units (each role accepted, unknown role rejected, roles satisfy the actionable-item rule); renderer menu spec + dispatch (undo/redo → muya methods, copyAsHtml → C-3, share → mt_share_file with the tab pathname, share absent for untitled tabs).

Constraints.Constraint: Undo/Redo must go through Muya history, never the webview undo role.
No new clipboard permissions; roles act via the responder chain.
Existing consumers (tabs/sidebar menus) unchanged — no role in their specs.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Paste as plain text (needs clipboard-read permission; separate consideration).
Services submenu / Look Up (no Tauri API).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Right-click shows the full menu; Cut/Copy/Paste behave exactly like the Edit-menu native items incl. auto-enablement; Paste pastes real clipboard content; Select All matches Cmd+A's context-aware Muya behavior.
Undo/Redo drive Muya history (same as Cmd+Z).
Share opens the native share sheet for the file; hidden for untitled tabs.
Rust + renderer suites green; CUA live check passes.

C-11.VerificationIntent: cargo test m009_menu (role validation); editor-coverage context-menu tests; CUA: right-click → verify item list, Paste inserts clipboard text, Undo reverts.
